name: Yunnan Energy New Material (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Yunnan Energy New Material (Group) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides film products in China and internationally. The company offers lithium-ion battery separator; BOPP films comprising cigarette film, flat film and special film; as well as special paper products, such as laser transfer anti-counterfeiting paper, direct-plated paper, and glassine paper. It also provides packaging printing products, including cigarette label and aseptic packaging products; and paper packaging, comprising special paper, holographic anti-counterfeiting anodized aluminum, and other products.
